items.title: Ex 99.1 to Form 8-K (CAT) 4Q 2025 Earnings Release - Press Release
items.snippet: Caterpillar announced fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results, noting the highest full-year sales and revenues in company history and a record backlog.

items.title: CATERPILLAR INC. Annual Report (2025 10-K)
items.snippet: Annual report discusses risks including valuation of Cat Financial’s leased equipment, residual value estimates, demand, and impairment/valuation considerations.

items.title: Caterpillar Inc. Q1 2025 Earnings Release
items.snippet: Company said its strategy for long-term profitable growth is delivering results and discussed first-quarter 2025 results.
